title: CandidateRecord
description: The ONE canonical per-finding record (output/candidates/<id>.json), built by build_candidate_records.py by joining merged_findings + fp_pattern_check + pre_submission_gate + findings_confirmed + min_confirm_gate + confirm_gate + runtime_poc + triage on finding id. `state` is the single definition of READY. Dashboard, triage, and report should read THIS, not re-join the source files.

evidence.description: report-readiness fields (review task 7). null when not yet derived; null required fields become readiness_blockers for High/Critical.

confirmation.description: multi-pass confirmation state. `required` is true for High/Critical. An unconfirmed required finding can never be `ready`.

gates.description: fp_action, any_fail, fail_gates[], warn_count, min_confirm_blocked, reachability_status

state.description: single derived state — the canonical READY definition

readiness_blockers.description: human-readable reasons this is not READY; empty == nothing blocking
